thread:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — CloudForge says marketplace listing is greenlit but procurement is holding the PO. They need DUNS + an amended MSA that covers EU data residency and a carveout for press/marketing approvals. Launch scheduled Thu, can we unblock?

Devin Chen (CloudForge): Sorry, this just bubbled up on our side. We can provide DUNS today. MSA redline uploaded: https://drive.cloudforge.com/msaredline_v2.pdf

Liz Torres: On it. Quick question — is the announcement clause their standard approval window or a stricter legal lock? If it's stricter we need to confirm marketing timing.

Ben Koch: Procurement is insisting on a 30-day approval window for any co-branded press — not typical for marketplace listings. Also they're asking for a contract-level data residency warranty; we usually handle data residency via SAs and subprocessor terms. Need product/legal alignment.

Sam Ruiz: From finance: to issue a PO we need vendor tax entity, remit-to, and DUNS. If DUNS comes today we can create a PO, but Legal needs a signed MSA before payment terms kick in. Also procurement is asking for NET 45 instead of our usual NET 30.

Olivia - Partner Ops: I'll coordinate signatures and vendor packet. Maya — can you confirm whether CloudForge accepts NET 45?

Devin Chen (CloudForge): NET 45 is fine. DUNS: 12-345-6789. We'll aim to review legal changes asap.

Liz Torres: I uploaded a light redline that: 1) reduces announcement approval window to 5 business days, and 2) adds the EU subprocessor/data residency clause in section 6. See diff: https://redwood.atlassian.net/links/msaredline-diff

Maya Patel: Great. Ben, can Deal Desk provision a conditional/contingent PO (PO_REF: PO-REDWOOD-XXXX) so partner can start onboarding while MSA is signed? Marketplace portal sometimes rejects partial POs though.

Ben Koch: We can issue a contingent PO internally, but the marketplace portal requires a fully executed PO to publish the listing. Two pragmatic paths: (A) expedite legal sign-off today and submit the PO; (B) onboard partner as an unlisted beta (no public marketplace listing) until executed. Which does marketing prefer?

Devin Chen (CloudForge): Option A is critical for joint press cadence. We'll push our legal too.

Maya Patel: Liz — can you prioritize review within the next 4 hours? If we get sign-off we can meet the marketplace publish window.

Liz Torres: Prioritizing now. Ping me in 15 if you have any additional redline asks. Starting review.

procurement-bot: PO_GENERATION_ATTEMPT blocked — missing: signed_msa

Olivia - Partner Ops: I'll prepare the contingent PO template and vendor packet so the moment the signed MSA is in, we can upload. Looping in marketing for embargo/announce timing.

Maya Patel: Thanks all — I'll update CloudForge PM and marketing. If anything stalls, @Ben Koch escalate to ops-sre for a portal upload workaround. :thumbsup:
